properties.notes: Demolition of existing buildings and erection of a part 6 part 7 storey mixed-use building with 416sqm of flexible commercial and employment floorspace at ground and first floor level (Use Classes A1, A2 and B1), 18 flats (6 x 1Bed, 8 x 2Bed & 4 x 3Bed) comprising 2 wheelchair accessible units in the upper floors and associated private amenity areas, landscaping, pedestrian access points, cycle parking and refuse storage.
